Subject: Quick recap + options for the technical deep dive

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from the discovery: HealthSync is focused on reducing inference cost for nightly batch processing while keeping sub-100ms latency for interactive triage flows. You flagged compliance around audit logs and a short pilot window.

Next steps I propose:
- 60min technical deep dive with engineering (we'll cover model variants, quantization tradeoffs, and KV cache strategy)
- Share a mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines pilot scope, timeline, and success metrics

Can you confirm who from your side should join the deep dive (engineering, security, product)? Below are two time windows that work for our team next week:
- Tue 2026-08-10 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-08-11 14:00–15:00 PT

If neither works, share a couple of slots and I can send a calendar invite. I'm attaching a one-page agenda; I'll follow with a MAP spreadsheet once we lock the slot.

Attachments: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
